notes:
I couldn't do any of the research, so I have no commentary notes for 1 Chronicles 2:29–55.

Every time I tried to search or open a page, the system blocked it with "You have no more code_execution tool calls remaining this turn." I didn't get to read even one page from the approved sites. You asked me to report only what pages actually say, with a link for each point, and not to fill gaps from my own knowledge. Writing notes now would break those rules, so I haven't written any.

**Next step:** if you send the request again in a new turn, I can do the research then. I'd plan to:

1. **Read the verse-by-verse sources:** Enduring Word on 1 Chronicles 2, the Bible Hub verse pages (for example biblehub.com/commentaries/1_chronicles/2-34.htm), and Gill, the Pulpit Commentary and Ellicott on StudyLight and Bible Hub. I'd also check whether Precept Austin covers this chapter.
2. **Look at the passages most likely to have comment:** Sheshan and his Egyptian servant Jarha (vv. 34–35), the Caleb lists and Acsah (vv. 42–49), Hur and Bethlehem (vv. 50–51), and the scribes, Kenites and Rechab (v. 55).
3. **Check the other views:** the NET Bible notes, which probably cover problems like the incomplete verse 43, and Bible Odyssey. I'd also search the Catholic and Orthodox sites and the tradition-specific sites. If none of them deal with this genealogy, I'll say so instead of filling the gap.

If you'd like, you can also paste the text of particular commentary pages here, and I'll work from those.
